summary_definitions.translation_fraction: Mean body velocity projected onto the commanded translation, divided by squared command speed; controls 100:1000.
summary_definitions.yaw_fraction: Mean body Z angular velocity divided by commanded yaw rate; controls 100:1000.
summary_definitions.feature_error: Maximum absolute difference between recorded AMP values and features reconstructed from native measurements.
summary_definitions.training_rows: 20 commands times 900 phase-zero transitions after the fixed two-second crop; export requires James’s motion acceptance.
